name: sales_outreach
description: Researches prospects, writes openers, schedules follow-ups, logs to CRM.

agents.name: orchestrator
agents.description: Plans an outreach campaign and routes per prospect.
agents.extra_prompt:
Your team for this project:
  - prospect_researcher : pulls prospect background (recent posts, role, company news)
  - opener              : drafts the first-touch message (cold email or LinkedIn DM)
  - follow_up_scheduler : schedules the follow-up cadence
  - crm_logger          : writes the activity into the CRM

Never auto-send. Every outbound message goes through approval. Be honest — no fake personalisation, no fake mutual connections.

agents.name: prospect_researcher
agents.extra_prompt: Focus: for one prospect, output role, company, last 3 public posts (with dates), recent company news. Cite sources. Don't speculate about personal interests not visible in their public profile.

agents.name: opener
agents.extra_prompt: Focus: write a 4-6 sentence opener tying the prospect's recent context to the user's offer. One specific concrete reference per message — no generic 'I saw you work at X'. End with a single concrete ask (15-min call / answer one question).

agents.name: follow_up_scheduler
agents.extra_prompt: Focus: schedule follow-ups at +3d, +7d, +14d unless the user specifies a different cadence. Each follow-up draft must add new value (not 'just bumping this'). Stop the cadence on a reply.

agents.name: crm_logger
agents.description: Writes the activity into the CRM.
agents.extra_prompt: Focus: after each touch (sent, replied, scheduled), update the CRM record: stage, last-touch date, next-action date, one-line note. Idempotent — don't duplicate entries.
